contributionMap.claim: Proof technique: Esscher centring at eta, then a uniform killed invariance principle giving the sine bulk, then stationary ladder overshoots at interval exits, then a stopped exponential (Dynkin) identity converting endpoint masses into exit transforms, then a Wiener–Hopf cancellation and a tightness plus Laplace-uniqueness extension to all b > 0
